# gyro_service_project (Resource)

Puts any existing service (DNS, storage, mail, containers, VDS, ...) into a project. Destroying it moves the service back to the default project. For gyro_server and gyro_load_balancer prefer their project_id argument; do not manage the same service with both.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Put any existing service (DNS, storage, mail, containers, VDS ...) into a project.
resource "gyro_service_project" "dns" {
  service_id = 17488
  project_id = tonumber(gyro_project.isinolacak.id)
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `project_id` (Number) gyro_project id, or 0 for the default project.
- `service_id` (Number) Service id (gyro_services, client area). Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Same as service_id.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import gyro_service_project.dns 17488
```
